source_title: 포에버 던전 가보니까 힐러 할 자신이 사라짐…
subtitle: 도트힐 걸고 하품하는 힐러의 한 마디 — ‘어째서 내가 그런 천한 행동을?’

cuts.speaker: 타우렌 드루이드
cuts.dialogue:
포에버 초반 던전…
도트힐 하나 감아두고 나니
할 게 없어서 너무 졸리네…
cuts.visual_prompt: Over-the-shoulder (OTS) diagonal shot from behind the shoulder of the Orc Warrior girl on the lower-right. On the lower-left, the Tauren Druid girl (bottom-row #8 on Draft C cast sheet) sits comfortably on a wooden camp stool, gently flicking a single green healing leaf spell into the air with one hand while covering a lazy yawn with the other. 100% pure solid #FFFFFF white borderless background, medium 2.5-to-3-head chibi scale, top 35% pure white headroom. Zero text, zero digits, zero speech bubbles.

cuts.speaker: 타우렌 드루이드
cuts.dialogue:
인던 돌면서 강아지
쓰다듬다 보면 저절로
잠들겠는데… 냐암…
cuts.visual_prompt: Side-profile 90-degree action shot on a 100% pure solid #FFFFFF white borderless background. The Tauren Druid girl leans back comfortably in a side-profile view, softly petting a cute fluffy cartoon wolf pup curled on her lap, eyes half-closed in sleepy bliss with a tiny floating snot bubble from her nose. Positioned on the right, leaving the left 46% clear white space. Medium 2.5-to-3-head chibi scale. Zero text, zero digits, zero speech bubbles.

cuts.speaker: 트롤 주술사
cuts.dialogue:
아니 회드님!
파티원들 피는 안 닳아도
남는 마나로 근접 평타라도 치쇼!!
cuts.visual_prompt: Dynamic Dutch tilt diagonal angle frame with tilted camera on a 100% pure solid #FFFFFF white borderless background. The Troll Shaman girl (middle-row #8 on Draft C cast sheet) is flinging her arms in frantic exasperation, clutching her wooden healing totem in one hand while yelling with sharp jagged shark teeth and flying sweat drops at the unperturbed druid! Medium 2.5-to-3-head chibi scale, top 35% pure white headroom. Zero text, zero digits.

cuts.speaker: 타우렌 드루이드
cuts.dialogue:
어째서 고귀한 힐러인 내가
그런 천하고 야만스러운 행동을
직접 해야 하는 것이지..?
cuts.visual_prompt: Dramatic low-angle shot looking up at the Tauren Druid girl (bottom-row #8 on Draft C cast sheet) on a 100% pure solid #FFFFFF white borderless background. She looks down her snout with supreme aristocrat disdain, a small folding fan delicately covering her mouth, eyes narrowed in pure noble contempt and royal haughtiness! Positioned on the right, left 46% clear space. Medium 2.5-to-3-head chibi scale. Zero text, zero digits, zero speech bubbles.

High-angle shot looking down at the Troll Shaman girl (middle-row #8 on Draft C cast sheet) in an expressive comedic freeze-frame on a 100% pure solid #FFFFFF white borderless background. She is falling backward in utter shock, her totem dropping to the floor, eyes spinning in dizzy spiral circles, completely struck dumb by the unbelievable noble arrogance! Expressive solo close-up filling ~78% height. Zero text, zero digits, zero speech bubbles.

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
와… 기세에 완전히 눌렸다.
저분이야말로 이 험한 아제로스의
진정한 황족 귀족 힐러다…!
cuts.visual_prompt: Back-view shot on a 100% pure solid #FFFFFF white borderless background. In the lower-left, the Orc Warrior girl is seen from behind with 1H axe and sturdy shield on back, bowing slightly with hands clasped in awe-struck starry-eyed reverence toward the queenly Tauren Druid on the right who poses with serene elegance. Medium 2.5-to-3-head chibi scale, top 34% pure white headroom. Zero text, zero digits, zero speech bubbles.
